$comment: Kyrve Phase 1 toolchain lock. Every value is normative and verified by `pnpm verify:toolchain`. Reproduction commands and the reasoning behind each pin are in docs/phase1/TOOLCHAIN.md. Never widen a pin to a range.

node.minimumReason: wrangler@4.115.0 declares engines.node >= 22.0.0. Cloudflare doc pages claiming 16.17 or 18 are stale; the engines field binds.

pnpm.exactPins: save-exact=true in .npmrc; no caret, tilde or range anywhere in the workspace

kyrveContracts.reason: Matches the pinned Midnight release exactly so runtime-bytecode comparison stays meaningful. PRD v1.1 A-1.

noxContracts.reason: The Nox SDK requires >=0.8.35 and the NoxCompute testnet deployment targets cancun, not osaka. Nox contracts therefore compile under a separate Hardhat profile and are never mixed with the Midnight settlement path.

hardhat.scope: spikes/nox and the permanent Nox compatibility suite only

cloudflare.planReason: Free plan allows 50 subrequests per invocation counting D1 and R2 calls, which cannot cover one block of indexing. PRD v1.1 A-13.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7.0.2 exists and is the published `latest`, but its compatibility with hardhat@3.11.1 and @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers@0.19.0 type surfaces is UNVERIFIED. 5.9.3 is the last stable 5.x and is what every pinned dependency was published against. Revisit only with an executable typecheck across all workspaces.

tooling.vitestReason: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers@0.19.0 peer-requires vitest ^4.1.0. 4.1.0 is the exact version Day 0 proved 6/6 workerd tests against; newer 4.1.x patches are unverified against workerd here.

morphoMidnight.licence: BUSL-1.1 on src/Midnight.sol; GPL-2.0-or-later on all other src files

libraries.viemWorkerdSupport: PROVEN — docs/day0/CLOUDFLARE-RUNTIME-GATE.md; re-proven every CI run by `pnpm verify:bundles`
